game.title: Darksiders III
game.blurb: Action adventure in the Darksiders series, from Gunfire Games and THQ Nordic, released 2018-11-27. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The hunt across a ruined Earth. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Artifacts, Upgrades and Levels
chapters.summary: Upgrading weapons, spending attribute points, reaching level 100 and collecting Angelic and Demonic Artifacts.

chapters.title: Optional Foes
chapters.summary: Meeting Targon and defeating Gor, Sherhaal, Rastion and Urul.

chapters.title: The Keepers and the Wings
chapters.summary: Finishing the Flame, Storm, Force and Stasis Wings and defeating the Void Defender Construct.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Armageddon Mode
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on any setting, on Normal and Apocalyptic, and in Armageddon mode.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 606280)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Darksiders_III
Fandom (darksiders.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://darksiders.fandom.com/wiki/Darksiders_III
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls subpages are linked but not written, and the only written subpage is a short "Table of Contents", so nothing was used. darksiders.fandom.com answers the API, with about 84 linked pages, including "Darksiders III: Keepers of the Void", "Darksiders III: The Crucible", the Seven Deadly Sins and many place names; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 44 of 64 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they all sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though names such as "Increased Capacity", "Maximum Vigor" and "Soul Reaper" sound like upgrade goals. The five "Keeper of" achievements (the four Wings and the Void Defender Construct) form their own chapter; Fandom lists an add-on page called "Keepers of the Void", but the achievement text does not name it, so the chapter is not called an expansion. The data does not say where Gor, Sherhaal, Rastion and Urul are fought, or whether Armageddon mode belongs to "The Crucible". RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low.
